theorems.name: Submission.eilenberg_compact_exhaustion
theorems.statement: ∀ (X : Type) [MetricSpace X] [SigmaCompactSpace X] [MeasurableSpace X] [BorelSpace X] (μ : Measure X) (A : Set X), NullMeasurableSet A μ → μ A < ⊤ → ∃ Q : ℕ → Set X, (∀ j, IsCompact (Q j)) ∧ (∀ j, Q j ⊆ A) ∧ Monotone Q ∧ μ (A \ ⋃ j, Q j) = 0
